cover_letter_text:
Hi Central Vic Civil team,

I'm Marc, and I'd like to start out as a junior project manager. I have a civil engineering degree from the Philippines (2019), and in February 2026 I graduated with an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design. Your advert says the role works closely with your senior project managers and directors, so I wanted to apply.

In 2019 I was project-in-charge on a community hall renovation that finished within its six-month program, coordinating 10 to 15 workers a day. After that, as field engineer, I tracked procurement and materials and wrote the progress reports.

I live in Melton and have my own car, a driver's licence and a White Card. I can start two weeks after an offer, and I also have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa). Thanks, and I hope to hear from you.

Kind regards,
Marc Masarate

questions.question: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
options: I'm a permanent resident and/or NZ citizen
I have a family/partner visa with no restrictions
I have a graduate temporary work visa
I have a holiday temporary work visa
I have a temporary visa with restrictions on work location (e.g. skilled regional visa 491)
I have a temporary protection or safe haven enterprise work visa
I have a temporary visa with no restrictions (e.g. doctoral student)
I have a temporary visa with restrictions on work hours (e.g. student visa, retirement visa)
I have a temporary visa with restrictions on industry (e.g. temporary activity visa 408)
I require sponsorship to work for a new employer (e.g. 482, 457)
questions.answer: I have a graduate temporary work visa

questions.question: What's your expected annual base salary?
